comparison.objective: Cut copper tube at a mark with a tubing cutter without denting or spiralling the cut.
comparison.physical_skill: Incremental force regulation, repeated orbital tool motion, and regrasping or handover.
comparison.success_condition: Tube cut through on-mark and square, remaining round, with hands clear of the cutter.
comparison.reason: This tests cyclic cutting and feed-force control, not end-face mating and longitudinal carriage transfer.
